data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisherman: 25 × 10 = 250 tons caught, leaving 250. That guarantees the lake returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome, sustaining $10,000 each per month. Larger catches risk future income; taking 19 each leaves only 25 and risks a severely depleted next month. I intend to request 10 if others support this plan. Please state your intended cap.
